artwork_type.title: Artwork type
artwork_type.description: Source type for the light box face.

text.title: Text
text.description: Text to display on the light box (when artwork_type=text). Alphanumeric and basic punctuation.

diffuser_gap.title: Diffuser gap
diffuser_gap.description: Gap between face plate and LED surface in millimeters.

led_cavity_depth.title: LED cavity depth
led_cavity_depth.description: Depth of the LED cavity inside the enclosure in millimeters.

back_style.title: Back style
back_style.description: How the back panel attaches to the enclosure.

cable_exit.title: Cable exit
cable_exit.description: Position of the cable routing notch.

mounting.title: Mounting
mounting.description: Mounting method for the assembled box.

rights_confirmed.title: Artwork rights confirmed
rights_confirmed.description: Confirm that you have permission to use the uploaded artwork.

artwork_data.title: Artwork data
artwork_data.description: Base64-encoded SVG or PNG data. Max 1 MB. Used when artwork_type is svg or png.

trace_threshold.title: Trace threshold
trace_threshold.description: Black/white threshold for PNG-to-SVG tracing (0=all white, 255=all black).

trace_smoothing.title: Trace smoothing
trace_smoothing.description: Curve smoothing factor for traced SVG paths.

material.title: Material
material.description: Filament material for print-time and cost estimation.

filament_price_per_kg.title: Filament price per kg
filament_price_per_kg.description: Estimated filament cost per kilogram in USD.

led_kit_cost.title: LED kit cost
led_kit_cost.description: Estimated cost of the LED strip/kit in USD.
